settings.a: Yes. Creating an account is free and starts you at Bronze with 500 welcome points.
Sign in before you check out, online or in store. Bronze earns 3%, Silver 7% and Gold 10% back in points on your order subtotal.

settings.q: How do I move up to Silver or Gold?
settings.a: Your spend over the year is tracked from paid orders. Silver unlocks at Rs 198,000 and Gold at Rs 300,000.
Once you have 2,500 points, open your account dashboard and choose Trade 2,500 points. We'll send your cash-off reward by email.

settings.q: What happens when I refund an order?
settings.a: The points earned on the refunded amount come off your balance, so it always stays accurate.

settings.q: Why hasn't my tier or balance updated yet?
settings.a: Points and tiers update once a paid order syncs. Use the same email at checkout as your account so your orders count.

settings.heading: Every order *pays* you back
settings.lead: Sri Lanka's premium supplement rewards club. Earn [bronze] to [gold] back in points on everything you buy, and climb to Silver and Gold as you go.
